items.title: One of the last survivors of Pearl Harbor lives in Virginia: ‘I was very lucky’
Tech-Savvy Students Reconnect Holocaust Survivors
items.description: Thanks to local junior high students, two long-lost friends have reconnected after more than 70 years apart.  Skokie resident Edith Westerfield and Seattle resident Gerda Katz met as young girls fleeing Nazi Germany in 1938.
